content.p: A person commits an offence if:
the person possesses a thing; and
the thing is tobacco (other than tobacco seed or tobacco plant); and

if the Court knows the day, or days, on which the offence was committed—that day, or the earliest of those days; or

if the person does not accept personal delivery—by putting it down in the person’s presence and telling the person the nature of the document; or

by leaving it at the address of the person’s place of residence or business last known to the person giving the document; or
by sending it by post to the address of the person’s place of residence or business last known to the person giving the document; or
by electronic communication to the person; or

by leaving a copy of the document at the ordinary place of business of the legal representative with a person who appears to work there;
